functions.name: getEntityDefinition
functions.notes: Lazy catalog construction under the 8551036 C++ static guard, followed by `(id-1)&255 <= 21` lookup into 23 records of 116 bytes at 8548368. 18 records are built by initializeEntityDefinition 56, 5 variants are moved by 166.

validation.comparison: Cold first lookups (ids 0, 1, 23, 257) and warm lookups for ids 1..23, 23 modulo-256 aliases and 15 invalid/extreme ids compare result, complete 67,108,864-byte memory and stack pointer. The cold path leaves the original 2192-byte descriptor frame byte-identical.
limitations: initializeEntityDefinition 56 and record move 166 remain native dependencies; their record layout writes are not duplicated in JS.
Guard acquire 32 and release 31 remain native dependencies; the acquire-failure branch was not observed because a clear guard always acquires.
The catalog has 23 slots, not 22: lookup rejects slot 22, so the Spider record (id 23, entityType 72) is built but unreachable through this function.
Ledger: 215 server bodies recovered and 519 remain machine code.
